aspect: Silence is not a decision and cannot be appealed
description: Appeal rights attach to determinations. Where nothing is determined, there is nothing to appeal, and the outcome is identical to refusal.
energy_note: Refused in effect, and never refused on paper.

aspect: It is cheaper for the institution than refusing
description: A refusal generates a file, a possible challenge and a statistic. Non-decision generates none of those, and produces the same result.
energy_note: The cheapest way to say no is to say nothing.

aspect: The target must keep everything alive while waiting
description: Job offers, course places, tenancies, medical appointments and the goodwill of whoever is sponsoring - all maintained indefinitely against a date nobody will give.
energy_note: Holding a life open for a date nobody will name.

description: A process slow enough causes a predictable share of applicants to give up, which is cheaper than deciding. Withdrawal is then recorded as the applicant's choice.
energy_note: Designed so that you stop asking.
notes: Same structure as ADM-004 in assets/text/general and the non-response rows in assets/text/palestine.
